notes.title: Skate & Date Release Date + Price!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Gensuta here. 
It's been a long time coming, but Skate & Date is officially launching on PC/Mobile on September 28th!!
It will be $10 and will be on sale for the first week it launches.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709123/23bf0116bed0c7b8c4516fa8f11d5cab267d62d7.png"]
(Even Maggie can't believe what she's hearing!)


I'm so excited to share this amazing story with you all, as this game is basically a love letter to my younger self. I wanted a rhythm game with black and brown queer people, and that's what you're going to get! 

While you wait, be sure to check out the Game Devs of Color Expo Steam Sale happening right now!
